_design: Three slimes in tight succession with a vine canopy overhead constraining max jump height for the middle slime. Slime 1 = free short-jump. Slime 2 = must short-jump (vine overhead crushes a hold-jump). Slime 3 = free, recovery. Essence between 2 and 3 is mid-air-low, only catchable if your slime-2 jump was a clean short-hop arc. Tests read-ahead and jump-arc discipline.

params.comment: vine constrains the middle jump — short-jump only
slime 2: must clear under vine — short-jump or die
reward catchable only on a clean short-jump apex
slime 3: recovery — back to free jump
